entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Dhanbad (Mahila) P. S. Case No. 30/2022,
registered under Sections 498A/ 504/ 506/ 406/ 323/ 324/ 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of Ms. Divya Raghav, learned J.M.F.C., Dhanbad.
Both the parties are present in the court.
It was submitted that the parties have settled their dispute and they are residing together.
Learned lawyer for the informant has affirmed this fact.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Ms. Divya Raghav, learned J.M.F.C., Dhanbad or her successor in connection with Dhanbad (Mahila) P. S. Case No. 30/2022, Subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
